:root { --bg: #12161c; --panel: #1a2029; --panel-2: #212836; --border: #2b3342; --text: #e7ebf1; --text-muted: #8792a3; --text-dim: #5b6577; --accent: #d9a441; --accent-soft: rgba(217,164,65,0.14); --mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", "Cascadia Mono", Consolas, monospace; --sans: -apple-system, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; --c-1962: #c957d6; --c-1978: #4f9fe0; --c-1995: #34c2ab; --c-1996: #e0c23a; --c-1997: #9aa4b2; --c-ref: #e0473a; } :root[data-theme="light"] { --bg: #f3f1ec; --panel: #ffffff; --panel-2: #f7f5f0; --border: #ddd8cc; --text: #23262b; --text-muted: #6b6f78; --text-dim: #9a9d a3; --accent: #b5791e; --accent-soft: rgba(181,121,30,0.12); } @media (prefers-color-scheme: light) { :root:not([data-theme="dark"]) { --bg: #f3f1ec; --panel: #ffffff; --panel-2: #f7f5f0; --border: #ddd8cc; --text: #23262b; --text-muted: #6b6f78; --text-dim: #9a9da3; --accent: #b5791e; --accent-soft: rgba(181,121,30,0.12); } } * { box-sizing: border-box; } body { margin: 0; background: var(--bg); color: var(--text); font-family: var(--sans); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.45; } .app { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) 340px; gap: 16px; padding: 16px; max-width: 1500px; margin: 0 auto; } @media (max-width: 980px) { .app { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } } header.top { grid-column: 1 / -1; display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding-bottom: 4px; flex-wrap: wrap; } header.top h1 { font-size: 17px; font-weight: 650; margin: 0; letter-spacing: 0.1px; } header.top .sub { color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 12.5px; } .mapwrap { background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 10px; overflow: hidden; position: relative; min-width: 0; } .basemap-picker { display: flex; gap: 4px; padding: 8px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--panel-2); } .basemap-picker button { font-family: var(--sans); font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 600; padding: 5px 10px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid transparent; background: none; color: var(--text-muted); cursor: pointer; } .basemap-picker button:hover { color: var(--text); } .basemap-picker button.active { background: var(--accent-soft); color: var(--accent); border-color: var(--accent); } .mapwrap .canvas-frame { position: relative; width: 100%; aspect-ratio: var(--ar); } canvas#stage { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; cursor: crosshair; } .scalebar { position: absolute; left: 14px; bottom: 14px; background: rgba(10,12,16,0.55); backdrop-filter: blur(2px); color: #fff; font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 11px; padding: 5px 8px 6px; border-radius: 5px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; pointer-events: none; } .scalebar .bar { height: 3px; background: #fff; border-radius: 1px; } .legend { position: absolute; top: 12px; left: 14px; background: rgba(10,12,16,0.55); backdrop-filter: blur(2px); border-radius: 7px; padding: 8px 10px; font-size: 11.5px; color: #fff; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; pointer-events: none; } .legend .row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; } .legend .swatch { width: 14px; height: 3px; border-radius: 2px; flex: none; } .legend .swatch.dash { background-image: linear-gradient(90deg, currentColor 60%, transparent 40%); background-size: 6px 3px; height: 3px; background-color: transparent; } aside.panel { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; min-width: 0; } .card { background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 10px; padding: 12px 13px; } .card h2 { font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: var(--text-muted); margin: 0 0 10px; font-weight: 650; } .layer-card { padding: 11px 13px 12px; } .layer-card + .layer-card { margin-top: 8px; } .layer-head { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 8px; } .layer-name { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-weight: 620; font-size: 13.5px; } .dot { width: 11px; height: 11px; border-radius: 50%; flex: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent-soft) inset; } .layer-name .dot { box-shadow: none; } .flag { font-size: 9.5px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: #d9a441; background: var(--accent-soft); padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 4px; font-weight: 700; } .vis-toggle { appearance: none; width: 30px; height: 17px; border-radius: 20px; background: var(--border); position: relative; cursor: pointer; flex: none; } .vis-toggle::after { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 2px; left: 2px; width: 13px; height: 13px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--text-dim); transition: transform .12s ease, background .12s ease; } .vis-toggle:checked { background: var(--accent-soft); } .vis-toggle:checked::after { transform: translateX(13px); background: var(--accent); } .axis-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 16px 1fr 62px; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-top: 6px; } .axis-row label { font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted); font-family: var(--mono); } .axis-row input[type="range"] { -webkit-appearance: none; appearance: none; width: 100%; height: 4px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--border); outline: none; } .axis-row input[type="range"]::-webkit-slider-thumb { -webkit-appearance: none; width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--layer-color, var(--accent)); border: 2px solid var(--panel); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--border); cursor: pointer; margin-top: -5px; } .axis-row input[type="range"]::-moz-range-thumb { width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--layer-color, var(--accent)); border: 2px solid var(--panel); cursor: pointer; } .axis-row input[type="number"] { width: 62px; background: var(--panel-2); border: 1px solid var(--border); color: var(--text); border-radius: 5px; padding: 3px 5px; font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 11.5px; text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .axis-row input[type="number"]::-webkit-inner-spin-button { opacity: 0.5; } .layer-foot { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-top: 9px; gap: 8px; } .shift-readout { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--text-muted); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .shift-readout b { color: var(--text); font-weight: 600; } button.reset-one { background: none; border: 1px solid var(--border); color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 10.5px; padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 5px; cursor: pointer; font-family: var(--sans); } button.reset-one:hover { border-color: var(--text-dim); color: var(--text); } .summary-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 11.5px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .summary-table th { text-align: right; font-family: var(--sans); font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 10.5px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; padding: 0 0 6px; } .summary-table th:first-child, .summary-table td:first-child { text-align: left; } .summary-table td { padding: 3px 0; text-align: right; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); } .summary-table td:first-child { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-family: var(--sans); font-weight: 600; padding-top: 6px; } .actions { display: flex; gap: 8px; margin-top: 12px; } button.primary, button.ghost { flex: 1; padding: 7px 10px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; font-family: var(--sans); } button.primary { background: var(--accent); border: 1px solid var(--accent); color: #1a1305; } button.primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } button.ghost { background: none; border: 1px solid var(--border); color: var(--text-muted); } button.ghost:hover { color: var(--text); border-color: var(--text-dim); } .copy-box { margin-top: 10px; background: var(--panel-2); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 9px; font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted); white-space: pre-wrap; display: none; } .copy-box.show { display: block; } .hint { font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--text-dim); margin-top: 2px; } ::selection { background: var(--accent-soft);
